array_sort_orders.operation_projection.records[].operation: OpenAPI evidence by source/path/key, then SDK occurrences by source/byte span/extractor/method, then handler literals by source/byte span/extractor/method
array_sort_orders.original_records: category order python_sdk_drift,typescript_sdk_drift,routes_missing_in_spec,routes_orphaned_in_spec,sdk_missing_from_both then historical source-array index

original_cohort.canonical_serialization: UTF-8; no BOM; object keys sorted; compact separators comma/colon; declared array orders; one terminal LF

id_encoding.algorithm: original_record_id = cdg1: + lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of id_payload bytes
id_encoding.id_payload: compact UTF-8 sorted-key JSON with exactly category, exact_historical_literal_record, schema=cdg-original-record-id-v1; separators comma/colon; no BOM; no trailing LF

operation_projection.one_to_many_rule: Each path-level original remains one membership record with method=null. Its separate operation_projection record has zero or more deterministic operation_edges, one for every distinct witnessed HTTP method at the normalized path; never fan out or duplicate original membership. This ratified artifact has zero unresolved route records and includes all historical OpenAPI, SDK-extractor, and explicit handler method-path literal witnesses.
operation_projection.record_digest_encoding: record_sha256 is lowercase SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 sorted-key JSON for that projection record with record_sha256 omitted; no BOM and no trailing LF

witness_dependencies.handler_witness_rule: explicit runtime-method token followed by an /api/ path literal in pinned server source; exact occurrence retained

original_record_id_set.digest_encoding: lowercase SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 sorted-key JSON with schema=cdg-original-record-id-set-v1 and original_record_ids sorted lexically; no BOM and no trailing LF

array_sort_orders.records: category order python_sdk_drift,typescript_sdk_drift then historical source-array index

sdk_provenance.canonical_serialization: UTF-8; no BOM; object keys sorted; compact separators comma/colon; declared array orders; one terminal LF

extraction_algorithm.canonical_provenance_atom: historical namespace filename stem, preserving hyphens and underscores exactly
extraction_algorithm.normalization: execute normalize_sdk_path semantics from the pinned normalizer blob; no later aliases or normalizer changes
extraction_algorithm.occurrence_retention: retain every exact regex occurrence that produces a ratified baseline literal; retain all distinct filename-stem atoms
extraction_algorithm.partition_rule: replace hyphen with underscore only; exact domain match or remove exactly one trailing s; any match is core; otherwise extended; missing or malformed provenance fails closed
extraction_algorithm.python_extractor: PY_REQUEST_RE from the pinned verifier blob
typescript_extractors: TS_REQUEST_RE from the pinned verifier blob
TS_DIRECT_RE from the pinned verifier blob
